subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only
stimulus: the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1×8= 8 (a) The dog was cured. (b) He found a mad dog and injected some weak germs of its disease into blood. (c) One day a boy named Joseph Meister was brought to Pasteur. (d) He had been bitten by a mad dog. (e) Pasteur was a French scientist. (f) Pasteur gave him some injections and the boy did not get dogs disease. (g) He discovered that many diseases are caused by gerins and he also found cures for several of them. (h) At first, he only treated animals, because he did not want to cause the death of any human being.
guide_solution: The parts of the story can appear in the following order: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 e g h b a c d f
